d.name: Far Cry®
d.desc: A tropical paradise seethes with hidden evil in Far Cry®, a cunningly detailed action shooter that pushes the boundaries of combat to shocking new levels. Freelance mariner Jack Carver is cursing the day he ever came to this island.
min: AMD Athlon™ 1 GHz or Pentium® III 1 GHz
64 MB DirectX® 9.0b-compliant graphics card (see supported list*)
DirectX 9.0b compliant PCI card (Sound Blaster Audigy series recommended)
rec: AMD Athlon 2-3 GHz or Pentium 4 2-3 GHz
Sound Blaster® Audigy® series (see supported list*)
128 MB GeForce™ 4 128 MB to GeForce FX 5950; ATI Radeon 9500-9800 XT
*Supported video cards at time of retail release

NVIDIA GeForce 2/3/4/FX families ( NVIDIA based cards must have ForceWare drivers 53.03 or later; GeForce 2 and GeForce 4 MX cards do not support all graphics features). ATI Radeon 8500/9000 families (ATI Radeon 9500-9800 XT recommended; ATI-based cards must have Catalyst drivers 3.9 or higher). Laptop models of the listed cards are not fully supported.
